description: Server-side conversion events posted to bzr.openai.com/v1/events, including the JSON event payload.

params.name: pid
params.description: It is the Pixel ID, and it travels on the query string.
params.fix_hint: Send `pid` as a query parameter on `/v1/events`.

params.name: events
params.description: The Conversions API posts events under `events`, and OpenAI documents that array as required.
params.fix_hint: Send at least one event in `events`.

params.name: integration_source
params.description: It names the integration sending the batch. OpenAI documents 1-64 ASCII characters, starting with a letter or digit.
params.fix_hint: Use a stable id such as `acme_measurement`. Start with a letter or digit; letters, digits, `.`, `_`, and `-` only.

params.name: validate_only
params.description: It validates events without saving them when `true`. OpenAI documents a boolean.
params.fix_hint: Send `true` or `false`, or omit `validate_only`.

params.name: id
params.description: It identifies the event for deduplication. OpenAI documents it as required on every event.
params.fix_hint: Set `id` to the same value the image tag sent as `event_id`.

params.name: type
params.description: It is the event type. OpenAI documents it as required. `app_installed` and `app_opened` are CAPI-only with `action_source=mobile_app`.
params.fix_hint: Set `type` to a documented event name.

params.name: timestamp_ms
params.description: It is the event time in milliseconds. OpenAI documents `timestamp_ms`, so a 10-digit seconds value is the wrong unit.
params.fix_hint: Send milliseconds, a 13-digit Unix timestamp.

params.name: custom_event_name
params.description: It names a custom event. OpenAI documents 1-64 letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit, and forbids standard event names.
params.fix_hint: Send `custom_event_name` when `type` is `custom`. Do not reuse a standard event name.

params.name: action_source
params.description: It names where the event happened. OpenAI documents `web`, `mobile_app`, `offline`, `physical_store`, `phone_call`, `email`, or `other`. `source_url` is required when this is `web`.
params.fix_hint: Set `action_source` to a documented source. Use `mobile_app` for `app_installed` and `app_opened`.

params.name: source_url
params.description: It is the page URL. OpenAI documents a URL with a scheme and host, required when `action_source` is `web`.
params.fix_hint: Send `source_url` on web events, such as `https://shop.example.com/checkout`.

params.name: oppref
params.description: It is an opaque OpenAI-provided attribution identifier. Pass the original string without modification.
params.fix_hint: Send `oppref` unchanged when you have it, or omit the field.

params.name: opt_out
params.description: It opts the event out of future user-level personalization when `true`. OpenAI documents a boolean.
params.fix_hint: Send `true` or `false`, or omit `opt_out`.

params.name: data
params.description: It describes the conversion. OpenAI documents `data` as required, with a `type` that matches the event.
params.fix_hint: Send a `data` object whose `type` is the shape documented for this event, such as `contents`.

params.name: data.type
params.description: It names the data shape. OpenAI documents `contents`, `customer_action`, `plan_enrollment`, or `custom`, matching the event.
params.fix_hint: Set `data.type` to the shape documented for this event.

params.name: data.amount
params.description: It is the event-level monetary value in the currency's minor unit. OpenAI documents an integer, such as `4200` for $42.00.
params.fix_hint: Send the amount as an integer in minor units, and send `data.currency`.

params.name: data.currency
params.description: It is the ISO 4217 currency code. OpenAI documents it as required when `amount` is present.
params.fix_hint: Send a three-letter code such as `USD`.

params.name: data.plan_id
params.description: It identifies a subscription or trial plan. OpenAI documents it on `plan_enrollment` and `custom` data.
params.fix_hint: Set `data.plan_id` to the plan id, or omit the field.

params.name: data.contents
params.description: It is the item list. OpenAI documents it on `contents`, `plan_enrollment`, and `custom` data, not on `customer_action`.
params.fix_hint: Send a `contents` array of item objects, or omit the field.

params.name: data.contents[].id
params.description: It is your internal item identifier.
params.fix_hint: Set `contents[].id` to the product or content id, or omit the field.

params.name: data.contents[].group_id
params.description: It identifies the product group or parent item. OpenAI documents it as Conversions API only.
params.fix_hint: Set `contents[].group_id` to the group id, or omit the field.

params.name: data.contents[].name
params.description: It is the item's display name.
params.fix_hint: Set `contents[].name` to the display name, or omit the field.

params.name: data.contents[].content_type
params.description: It describes the item category, such as `product`, `plan`, or `page`.
params.fix_hint: Set `contents[].content_type` to a non-empty category, or omit the field.

params.name: data.contents[].quantity
params.description: It is the item quantity. OpenAI documents an integer, not a string.
params.fix_hint: Send `contents[].quantity` as an integer.

params.name: data.contents[].amount
params.description: It is the item-level monetary value in the currency's minor unit. OpenAI documents an integer.
params.fix_hint: Send `contents[].amount` as an integer in minor units.

params.name: data.contents[].currency
params.description: It is the ISO 4217 currency code for the item.
params.fix_hint: Send a three-letter code such as `USD`, or rely on event-level `data.currency`.

params.name: data.contents[].variant_dict
params.description: It is an object of string keys and values, such as size and color. OpenAI documents it as Conversions API only.
params.fix_hint: Send `contents[].variant_dict` as an object of strings, such as `{"size": "medium", "color": "blue"}`.

params.name: user
params.description: It is the optional conversion-matching object. OpenAI documents it as event-scoped. Include only fields you have.
params.fix_hint: Send a `user` object with match keys, or omit it.

params.name: user.emails_sha256
params.description: It is a SHA-256 digest of a normalized email. OpenAI documents lowercase 64-character hex.
params.fix_hint: Trim, lowercase, SHA-256, and send 64 lowercase hex characters.

params.name: user.emails_sha256[]
params.description: Every email in the list must be a SHA-256 digest.
params.fix_hint: Trim, lowercase, SHA-256, and send 64 lowercase hex characters.

params.name: user.phone_numbers_sha256
params.description: It is a SHA-256 digest of a normalized phone number. OpenAI documents lowercase 64-character hex.
params.fix_hint: Normalize to 8-15 digits, SHA-256, and send 64 lowercase hex characters.

params.name: user.phone_numbers_sha256[]
params.description: Every phone number in the list must be a SHA-256 digest.
params.fix_hint: Normalize to 8-15 digits, SHA-256, and send 64 lowercase hex characters.

params.name: user.external_ids_sha256
params.description: It is a SHA-256 digest of a stable customer id. OpenAI documents lowercase 64-character hex.
params.fix_hint: Trim, SHA-256, and send 64 lowercase hex characters.

params.name: user.external_ids_sha256[]
params.description: Every external id in the list must be a SHA-256 digest.
params.fix_hint: Trim, SHA-256, and send 64 lowercase hex characters.

params.name: user.first_names_sha256
params.description: It is a SHA-256 digest of a normalized first name. OpenAI documents lowercase 64-character hex.
params.fix_hint: Lowercase, strip whitespace and ASCII punctuation, SHA-256, and send 64 lowercase hex characters.

params.name: user.first_names_sha256[]
params.description: Every first name in the list must be a SHA-256 digest.
params.fix_hint: Lowercase, strip whitespace and ASCII punctuation, SHA-256, and send 64 lowercase hex characters.

params.name: user.last_names_sha256
params.description: It is a SHA-256 digest of a normalized last name. OpenAI documents lowercase 64-character hex.
params.fix_hint: Lowercase, strip whitespace and ASCII punctuation, SHA-256, and send 64 lowercase hex characters.

params.name: user.last_names_sha256[]
params.description: Every last name in the list must be a SHA-256 digest.
params.fix_hint: Lowercase, strip whitespace and ASCII punctuation, SHA-256, and send 64 lowercase hex characters.

params.name: user.countries
params.description: It is a two-letter country code, such as `US`.
params.fix_hint: Send ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, such as `US`.

params.name: user.countries[]
params.description: Every country in the list must be a two-letter code, such as `US`.
params.fix_hint: Send ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, such as `US`.

params.name: user.cities
params.description: It is a raw city name. OpenAI documents geographic values as unhashed strings, limited to 128 characters after normalize.
params.fix_hint: Send the city as a raw string of at most 128 characters, or omit the field.

params.name: user.cities[]
params.description: Every city in the list must be a raw, unhashed name of at most 128 characters.
params.fix_hint: Send each city as a raw string of at most 128 characters.

params.name: user.regions
params.description: It is a raw region value. OpenAI documents geographic values as unhashed strings, limited to 128 characters after normalize.
params.fix_hint: Send the region as a raw string of at most 128 characters, or omit the field.

params.name: user.regions[]
params.description: Every region in the list must be a raw, unhashed value of at most 128 characters.
params.fix_hint: Send each region as a raw string of at most 128 characters.

params.name: user.postal_codes
params.description: It is a raw postal or ZIP code. OpenAI documents letters, numbers, spaces, or hyphens, up to 32 characters.
params.fix_hint: Send the postal code as a raw string of letters, numbers, spaces, or hyphens.

params.name: user.postal_codes[]
params.description: It is a raw postal or ZIP code. OpenAI documents letters, numbers, spaces, or hyphens, up to 32 characters.
params.fix_hint: Send the postal code as a raw string of letters, numbers, spaces, or hyphens.

params.name: user.android_advertising_id
params.description: It is a raw Android GAID in UUID format. OpenAI documents it as Conversions API only; IDFA is not supported.
params.fix_hint: Send the GAID as a UUID. Do not send IDFA.

params.name: user.obref
params.description: It is the opaque browser reference from the Pixel `__obref` cookie. Pass it without hashing.
params.fix_hint: Send the `__obref` cookie value unchanged, or omit the field.

params.name: user.ip_address
params.description: It is a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address. OpenAI documents it as unhashed.
params.fix_hint: Send the client IP as IPv4 or IPv6, not a hash.

params.name: user.user_agent
params.description: It is the raw user agent from the client that generated the event. OpenAI documents it as unhashed.
params.fix_hint: Send the client user agent string, not a hash.

rules.message: The event is marked `action_source: web` but carries no `source_url`. OpenAI documents the page URL as required for web events.
`type` is `custom` but `custom_event_name` is missing. OpenAI documents that name as required for custom events.
rules.fix_hint: Set `custom_event_name` to 1-64 letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens.

rules.message: The event is `app_installed` or `app_opened` but carries no `action_source`. OpenAI documents `action_source` as `mobile_app` for those events.
The event is `app_installed` or `app_opened` but `action_source` is not `mobile_app`. OpenAI documents that source for app lifecycle events.
This event requires `data.type` `contents`. OpenAI documents that shape for page, content, cart, and order events.
This event requires `data.type` `customer_action`. OpenAI documents that shape for app, appointment, lead, and registration events.
This event requires `data.type` `plan_enrollment`. OpenAI documents that shape for subscription and trial events.
A `custom` event requires `data.type` `custom`. OpenAI documents that shape for custom events.
A standard event carries `custom_event_name`. OpenAI documents that field as required for `custom` and omitted otherwise.
`data.type` is `customer_action` but the event carries `data.contents`. OpenAI documents contents as unavailable on that shape.
This data shape carries `data.plan_id`. OpenAI documents `plan_id` on `plan_enrollment` and `custom` only.
The event carries `data.amount` with no `data.currency`. OpenAI documents currency as required whenever amount is set.
rules.fix_hint: Add `data.currency` as an ISO 4217 code alongside the amount.

rules.message: `custom_event_name` matches a standard event name. OpenAI documents that a custom name cannot reuse a built-in event.
rules.fix_hint: Pick a name that is not a standard event, such as `quote_requested`.

rules.message: A field carries what looks like a raw email address. OpenAI requires emails to be normalized and SHA-256 hashed before they are sent.
rules.fix_hint: Trim the address, lowercase it, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest in `user.emails_sha256`.

rules.message: This field looks like a SHA-256 digest, but OpenAI documents it as an unhashed string.
rules.fix_hint: Send the raw value. Hashing `ip_address`, `user_agent`, geo fields, or `obref` makes the event unmatchable.

rules.message: `android_advertising_id` is the all-zero UUID. OpenAI documents that the API ignores it without rejecting the event.
rules.fix_hint: Send a real GAID, or omit `android_advertising_id`.
